title: Mapilak Line 5 Banana: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaTitle: Mapilak Line 5 Banana: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaDescription: Mapilak Line 5 banana is a banana variety from Institute of Plant Breeding. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Mapilak Line 5 is a registered banana variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2021 as NSIC 2021 Bn 05. Institute of Plant Breeding bred it. Its record notes a yield of 12.96kg.

blocks.text: Compare it with the others in our [banana variety finder](/crop-varieties/banana), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [banana farming in the Philippines](/crops/banana-farming-philippines).
Key facts about Mapilak Line 5 banana
When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. Its record notes a yield of 12.96kg. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit banana fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Banana aphid](/pests/banana-aphid), [Banana bunchy top](/diseases/banana-bunchy-top), [Banana weevil](/pests/banana-weevil), [black sigatoka](/diseases/black-sigatoka). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A fruit of Mapilak Line 5 weighs about 115.57 grams, and its shape is slightly curve to straight. The flesh is yellow orange and firm.
Where and when to plant Mapilak Line 5 banana

Lakatan and latundan sell fresh, saba goes to cooking and banana cue, and Cavendish goes to export. Fusarium wilt and bunchy top end many farms, so plant clean tissue cultured plantlets, and a tolerant selection where wilt is known. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for banana](/land-preparation/banana-land-preparation).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of Mapilak Line 5?
